title: ISM Manufacturing PMI (Oct 2026 data)
source: ISM: the September-data ISM Manufacturing report (PRNewswire 302894520, 'Manufacturing PMI® at 54.5%; September 2026 ISM® Manufacturing PMI® Report', issued 2026-10-01 10:00 ET) names its own successor verbatim — "The next ISM® Manufacturing PMI® Report featuring October 2026 data will be released at 10:00 a.m. ET on Monday, November 2, 2026." Read first-hand on prnewswire.com/news-releases/manufacturing-pmi-at-54-5-september-2026-ism-manufacturing-pmi-report-302894520.html by this event's own pulse 2026-10-13 and independently on a wire mirror (miningstockeducation.com) carrying the same sentence. Promoted estimate -> confirmed on that line: the dated promotion path this entry recorded on 2026-09-08 (FT-48), the same one ism-manufacturing-2026-10-01 took on 2026-09-05. Supersedes the prior EST: derivation (first-business-day rule, 2 U.S.C. § 7 cross-check, Atlanta Fed workbook line), all of which the wire sentence now agrees with. ismworld.org's own ROB calendar remains SSO-gated (302 to ecommerce.ismworld.org/SSO, re-hit 2026-10-13) and was not needed. Checked 2026-10-13
notes: The first manufacturing read after the 10-28 FOMC and the last hard macro print before the 11-03 midterms (est). Prices-paid + new-orders reprice the Fed-cut path and 10Y real yields, the discount rate on long-duration tech. Discovered during the sloos-2026-11-02 initial research. Two amendments from the 2026-09-08 pulse: (1) the shutdown branch this entry was partly weighted on is DEAD — H.R. 6500 was signed 2026-09-02 (PL 119-103), funding agencies through 12-11, so October is funded and the 11-06 payrolls report will print; this is one October read among several, not the only one. (2) The 11-02 morning is denser than the original note assumed: it now carries four tracked items, not two — this print and sloos-2026-11-02 plus the confirmed construction-spending-2026-11-02 sharing the exact 10:00 ET slot and treasury-borrowing-estimates-2026-11-02 the same day. Impact stays high on the sequence fact (last hard national activity read before the vote), not on informational share. No tradeable edge has ever been measured off this release; see the ledger. PROMOTED estimate -> confirmed 2026-10-13: the 2026-10-01 September-data report names this date verbatim (see source); impact stays high on the sequence fact.
